operator_fields.operator_summary: Runtime quality remains high, but the experiment misses its intended closure. Episode 7 preserves continuity and observer pressure, yet defers actual fill/immediate consequence into a new headquarters-safehouse negotiation. This is a loop-design miss, not a prose-quality miss.
operator_fields.next_action: Do not treat actual market consequence as proved. The next useful move is a seam audit on why ignition escalated into new infrastructure setup, then a bounded rerun aimed at immediate fill/consequence rather than further access negotiation.
